title: Additive Manufacturing for Electric Vehicle Motors
key_point: ARPA-E funded layer-by-layer deposition of copper and insulation for ultra-high-efficiency, reduced-rare-earth EV motor concepts.；Completed R&D project, not current commercial availability evidence.

title: ASTM B193-25 — Resistivity of Electrical Conductor Materials
key_point: 金属导体电阻率测定；用于把电阻率换算为导电率时必须记录温度、尺寸、密度与取向。

title: ASTM E1461-13(2022) — Thermal Diffusivity by the Flash Method
key_point: 闪光法测热扩散率；配合密度和比热可推导热导率，报告时应写明测试温度与方向。

title: ASTM Additive Manufacturing Standards Help Meet Customer Needs
key_point: 常用粉末方法包括激光散射粒度、筛分、霍尔流速和松装/振实密度；应报告方法而非只给 D10/D50/D90。

title: ASTM F3530 Design Guidance for PBF-LB Metal Post-Processing
key_point: 铜高热导会快速抽走熔池热量；复杂几何仍可能产生陡峭热梯度、局部收缩、变形、脱板和支撑失效。

title: Additive Manufacturing of Pure Niobium and Copper for Particle Accelerators
key_point: The team produced 6 GHz copper cavity prototypes and investigated surface treatments to reduce roughness from about 35 μm to below 1 μm.；Prototype research; RF and cryogenic qualification must be traced to later test reports.

title: Pure copper membranes by green laser powder bed fusion
key_point: The work studies wall thickness, orientation, microstructure, properties and vacuum tightness for green-laser LPBF pure-copper membranes.；Research evidence; extract exact acceptance values from the paper before quoting numeric claims.

title: First Proof-of-Concept Prototype of an Additive Manufactured Radio Frequency Quadrupole
key_point: The collaboration designed and LPBF-produced a pure-copper quarter section of a 750 MHz 4-vane RFQ with integrated cooling features.；Proof-of-concept; surface, vacuum and high-power RF qualification were continuing work.

title: Additive Manufacturing of Metals and Multi-Material
key_point: Fraunhofer IGCV describes additively made tungsten preforms followed by copper infiltration for tailored W-Cu plasma-facing heat-sink structures.；Research route; fusion component qualification requires high-heat-flux, joining and irradiation evidence.

title: Green Light for New 3D Printing Process
key_point: Fraunhofer ILT demonstrated green-laser LPBF of pure copper and an internally cooled induction coil.；Early process-development evidence; do not quote as a current production throughput benchmark.

title: Green laser melts pure copper
key_point: Fraunhofer IWS reports more than 70% absorption with a green laser and identifies heat sinks, motors, coils and aerospace cooling as target applications.；Research-center capability statement; final properties depend on machine, powder and parameter set.

title: Add or discover new sources for your notebook
key_point: 桌面版支持 DOCX、TXT、Markdown、PDF、CSV、网页、YouTube 等来源；本地来源单项上限为 500,000 words 或 200 MB。

title: Upgrade NotebookLM
key_point: 不同方案的 notebook 与 source 数量限额不同；免费方案的单 notebook source 限额应以 Google 当前页面为准。

title: ISO/ASTM 52904:2024 — Metal PBF for critical applications
key_point: 覆盖关键应用中金属 PBF 设备运行与生产控制，适用于激光束和电子束 PBF。

title: ISO/ASTM 52907:2019 — Methods to characterize metal powders
key_point: 覆盖金属粉末的文件、追溯、取样、粒度、成分、密度、形貌、流动、污染、包装和储存。

title: ISO/ASTM 52908:2023 — Post-processing, inspection and testing of metal PBF parts
key_point: 用于金属 PBF 成品的后处理、检验和测试框架。

title: ISO/ASTM 52920:2023 — Requirements for industrial AM processes and production sites
key_point: 定义增材制造生产现场沿制造流程的质量保证措施，并与 ISO 9001、EN 9100 等体系互补。

title: ITER first-wall qualification program
key_point: ITER describes copper-alloy heat sinks bonded to plasma-facing armor and phased qualification from small mockups through full-scale prototypes.；Demand and qualification reference; the cited ITER panels are not evidence of an AM copper production route.

title: 2024 Invention of the Year — Thrust Chamber Liner and Fabrication Method
key_point: NASA describes a one-piece GRCop-42 chamber/nozzle route using LPBF and LP-DED, with integrated cooling and multi-material design.；Use as technology validation, not as a supplier performance guarantee.

title: 3D Printed Rocket Launched Using Innovative NASA Alloy
key_point: NASA states Terran 1 used nine additively manufactured engines made with GRCop copper alloy and experienced temperatures approaching 6,000°F.；A flight event, not proof that every AM copper engine design is flight-qualified.

title: Long Life Additive Manufacturing Assembly (LLAMA)
key_point: NASA 将 GRCop-42 铜-铬-铌合金用于燃烧室，利用高导热、高温强度和减少接头来提高可靠性。

title: Additive Manufacturing of GRCop-42 Alloy
key_point: GRCop-42 LPBF 的工艺、显微组织与性能研究；参数仅可视为对应设备和材料批次下的研究样例。

title: Directed Energy Deposition Additive Manufacturing of GRCop-42 Copper Alloy
key_point: GRCop-42 的定向能量沉积研究，补充 LPBF 之外的大尺寸/修复路线。

title: Progress in Additively Manufactured GRCop-84, GRCop-42, and Bimetallic Combustion Chambers
key_point: NASA documented LPBF of GRCop-42/84, DED bimetallic chambers, material characterization and hot-fire testing with multiple propellants.；Research and qualification evidence; not a blanket production certification.

title: A One-piece Liquid Rocket Thrust Chamber Assembly
key_point: RAMPT combines an integral-channel GRCop chamber, bimetallic interface, large-scale DED nozzle and composite overwrap; NASA reports over 40% weight reduction for the assembly concept.；Patent/technology-transfer description; application-specific qualification remains necessary.

title: Powder Bed Fusion research and metrology
key_point: 覆盖粉末铺展、原位测量、建模与控制等 PBF 测量科学问题。

title: Ultra-high-speed printing regime in laser powder bed fusion of highly reflective metals
key_point: 研究指出高反射金属存在能量损失，并展示 400 W、>4 m/s 的特定超高速机制；这是单项研究窗口，不是通用工艺配方。

title: Additive Manufacture of In-situ Steel-Copper Alloy for Improved Tooling Performance
key_point: ORNL describes DED mixing of steel and copper to place thermal conductivity where needed in tooling while retaining hardness elsewhere.；Technology disclosure; industrial cycle-life and interface qualification remain application-specific.

title: Additively manufactured lattice-based copper heat sinks
key_point: ORNL records design, simulation and testing of MEX copper lattice heat sinks, including debind, sinter and HIP effects.；Research-scale heat-sink evidence; compare against application-specific thermal resistance and pressure-drop baselines.

title: Advancements in 3D printing and HIP of copper
key_point: ORNL records MEX copper shrinkage, 93% sintered density, 98% density after HIP and conductivity rising from 86% to 100% IACS for the studied route.；Specific feedstock, debind/sinter/HIP cycle and specimen geometry; not universal MEX performance.

title: Exploration of Binder Jet Additive Manufacturing for Automotive Heat Sink Component Fabrication
key_point: ORNL and Magna evaluated binder-jet copper heat sinks using capillary-driven fluid transport for EV range/life benefits and production scalability.；Phase-1 feasibility work; do not imply vehicle production qualification.

title: ASTM Additive Manufacturing Technology Related Standards
evidence_level: ASTM 官方标准列表/设备数据表
key_point: 至少区分水平/垂直方向、成形态/热处理态、机加工/近净表面，并记录取样位置。

title: ASTM F3637-23 Relative Density Measurement
evidence_level: ASTM 官方指南/同行评审综述
key_point: 体能量输入不足、道间距过大、层厚过厚、铺粉缺口或送粉过量会留下不规则、尖角状未熔合孔，疲劳危害高。

title: 3D printing for a water-cooled fusion mirror
key_point: DOE/PPPL describes a water-cooled mirror assembly involving stainless-steel and copper components produced through metal AM for a fusion heating system.；Early prototype story; verify which regions/materials were additively deposited and subsequent testing.

title: Navy ManTech Project Book — SPEE3D for Rapid, Low-Cost Navy Components
key_point: Navy ManTech identifies casting lead-time pressure and development of cold-spray NAB and 70/30 CuNi materials/components for submarine and carrier platforms.；Development/transition program; do not claim unrestricted fleet approval.

title: Metal Fused Filament Fabrication: Distortion Compensation & CO2 Electrochemical Reduction
organization: University of Texas at El Paso
key_point: The dissertation investigates MEX-printed and sintered copper electrodes, using porosity for electrochemical nitrate reduction and ammonia production.；Academic research, not industrial reactor validation or commercial performance.

title: 3D-printed Electric Motors
key_point: Additive Drives describes printed copper windings, busbars with up to 60% less material, four-week hairpin prototypes and 48–1200 V / up to 800 kW design coverage.；Company performance claims; require motor-specific efficiency maps, thermal tests and insulation validation.

title: 3D Printing for Semiconductors
key_point: EOS reports a Delvy copper heat exchanger with over 300% increase in dissipative surface area and positions AM for semiconductor thermal and fluid systems.；Supplier case; ask for baseline geometry, pressure drop, duty cycle and measured thermal resistance.

title: Copper for Industrial 3D Printing
key_point: EOS lists pure copper and copper-alloy options, typical mechanical properties and applications in heat exchangers, electronics, motors and rocket propulsion.；Portfolio overview; each material-machine-process combination has a separate data sheet and TRL.

title: EOS CopperAlloy CuCrZr Material Data Sheet
key_point: CuCrZr（C18150/CW106C）系统材料，80 µm 层厚定位高生产率，列举火箭发动机、换热器和感应线圈应用。

title: Material Data Sheet — EOS Copper CuCP
key_point: EOS CuCP data sheet provides density/defect and mechanical-property test conditions for commercially pure copper on a qualified EOS route.；Always record machine, orientation, heat treatment, powder state and data-sheet revision.

title: Leak-Free Liquid Cooled Heat Sinks
key_point: CoolestDC and EOS describe a joint-free CuCP server cold plate, tested at 6 bar and above, with internal walls from 0.2 mm.；A specific design/process case; pressure proof is not equivalent to lifetime, corrosion or system qualification.

title: New CopperAlloy CuNi30 With Corrosion Resistance
key_point: The partners developed LPBF CuNi30 for U.S. submarine-industrial-base supply pressure; EOS reports about 510 MPa UTS, over 20% elongation and UNS C96400 mechanical performance.；Material-route announcement; part approval still requires naval drawings, NDE and authority acceptance.

title: 3D Printing of Metal Microcoils and Helices
key_point: Exaddon shows pure-copper microcoils down to 10 μm diameter capability and a 20 μm coil produced for Harvard Medical School research; reported conductivity is about 87% of bulk copper.；Research-use and supplier capability; not clinical approval evidence.

title: Exaddon — semiconductor wafer probing focus
key_point: Exaddon states industrial focus on semiconductor wafer probing using high-precision micro-3D-printed metal structures.；Company positioning; request probe lifetime, contact resistance and customer qualification evidence.

title: High Frequency Technologies with micro-AM
key_point: Exaddon describes pure-copper micro-waveguides and helices for TWT/mmWave/5G/THz applications, including a 66 GHz helix example.；Supplier application evidence; RF performance depends strongly on geometry, surface and integration.

title: Aerospace RF Antennas
key_point: Fabric8Labs describes monolithic pure-copper RF, antenna, interconnect and cooling features built directly on PCBs, ceramics and silicon for SWaP-C applications.；Capability/market statement; flight and RF qualification data remain program-specific.

title: Data Center Liquid Cooling
key_point: Fabric8Labs positions room-temperature ECAM for pure-copper cold plates, micron-scale features, direct-on-substrate build and power-map-specific cooling.；Company capability statement; request independent thermal, pressure and reliability data for each design.

title: Electrochemical Additive Manufacturing Technology
key_point: Fabric8Labs states 33 μm voxels, 99.95% pure ECAM copper, room-temperature processing and no property-development post-processing.；Vendor data; distinguish voxel size from minimum qualified channel, wall or tolerance.

title: Copper Induction Coils
key_point: GKN states DMLS CuCr1Zr one-piece induction coils with internal cooling, elimination of brazed joints and 20% energy savings in its application description.；Case-specific supplier claim; verify baseline coil, frequency, cooling and service life.

title: PureForm additive manufacturing technology
key_point: Holo reports sinter-based PureForm copper at 99.9% purity with thermal and electrical conductivity comparable to bulk copper.；Company claim; request exact conductivity, density, geometry limits and lot data.

title: Copper Material Datasheet
key_point: Markforged reports as-sintered copper at minimum 99.8% Cu, 98% relative density, 84% IACS and 350 W/m·K, with specified ASTM methods.；Route-specific typical values; not interchangeable with LPBF, cold spray or wrought copper.

title: SPEE3D Copper material data
key_point: SPEE3D reports heat-treated pure copper at typical 95% IACS and 380 W/m·K, with applications including busbars, heat sinks, molds and antimicrobial coatings.；Vendor route data; note orientation, anneal schedule, oxygen content and machining allowance.

title: WarpSPEE3D large-format cold-spray system
key_point: SPEE3D lists pure-copper capability, parts up to Ø1 m × 0.7 m, 40 kg, and deposition rates up to 100 g/min for the system.；System maxima are not simultaneous guarantees for every geometry/material-property target.

title: Antiviral Copper to Fight COVID-19
key_point: SPEE3D reports NATA-accredited testing in which ACTIVAT3D copper surfaces inactivated 96% of SARS-CoV-2 in two hours and 99.2% in five hours, plus five-minute touch-plate coating.；Surface-test evidence; not a medical-device approval, infection-control guarantee or substitute for cleaning.

title: Green laser from TRUMPF prints copper and gold
key_point: 绿色激光提高铜对激光能量的耦合，是纯铜 LPBF 商业化的重要设备路线。

title: TRUMPF Additive Manufacturing Aerospace Flyer — E-drive concept demonstrator
key_point: TRUMPF presents individually designed pure-copper coils printed on a green-laser system and reports over 100% IACS for the demonstrator material route.；Demonstrator data; confirm measurement method, heat treatment, geometry and production repeatability.

title: TruPrint 1000 Green Edition flyer
key_point: 资料宣称 515 nm、Cu-ETP >99.9%、100% IACS，孔隙率远低于 0.5%；属于厂商声明，采购前需索取当前版本与测试条件。

title: Pure-copper core component for CERN-coordinated I.FAST
key_point: TRUMPF reports one-piece additive manufacture of a nearly 400 mm tall pure-copper accelerator component on a green-laser system.；Demonstrator/collaboration result, not unrestricted accelerator production qualification.

title: Study highlights promise of 3D printing for electrochemical reactors
key_point: Cornell highlights how AM geometry can improve gas distribution, mass transport, yield and efficiency in electrochemical CO2 reactors.；The highlighted printed structures are not bulk-metal copper parts; use as reactor-design logic only.

title: 3D-printed dual-reflector antenna
key_point: ESA tested a one-piece polymer antenna plated with copper and reported satisfactory prototype RF performance.；Not metal copper AM; use only to explain the separate route of printed substrate plus copper plating.

title: Conformal cooling solutions prove a boost to moulding productivity
key_point: Kärcher reported 55% cooling-time reduction and daily output increase from 1,496 to 2,101 using AM conformal-cooled inserts and other process changes.；The printed inserts were steel, not copper; use only as an adjacent economic benchmark, clearly labeled.

title: 3D Systems DMP Factory 350 (1 kW single-laser configuration) product page
key_point: 当前公开设备资料常见500 W/双500 W版本；纯铜必须向厂商确认1 kW单激光配置及认证参数包。

title: 3D Systems DMP Flex 350 (1 kW single-laser configuration) copper evidence
key_point: A-官方明确：3D Systems官方材料页明确指定1 kW单激光DMP Flex 350可打印认证无氧纯铜。

title: 3D Systems DMP Flex 350 (1 kW single-laser configuration) product page
key_point: 纯铜资格限定为官方所述1 kW单激光配置；标准500 W或双激光配置不可自动视为同一纯铜工艺。

title: 3D Systems official website
key_point: Current commercial

title: AML3D ARCEMY family copper evidence
key_point: C-仅铜合金：AML3D官方材料页列多种铜镍/铝青铜合金，没有纯铜。

title: AML3D ARCEMY family product page
key_point: ARCEMY有多种尺寸版本，本行作为产品族边界记录；海洋用铜镍合金是重点，不是高导纯铜。

title: AML3D official website
key_point: Current commercial; copper-alloy evidence only

title: ATLIX (formerly TRUMPF Additive Manufacturing) official website
key_point: Legacy product; portfolio migrated from TRUMPF to ATLIX in 2025, confirm current quotation

title: Desktop Metal official website
key_point: Historical/discontinued; Desktop Metal filed Chapter 11 and assets were sold in 2025

title: Desktop Metal Production System P-1 copper evidence
key_point: A-官方明确（历史资料）：Desktop Metal官方Pure Cu数据表覆盖Production System，给出材料性能。

title: Desktop Metal Production System P-1 product page
key_point: 保留作代表性历史系统。2026年Nano Dimension官方年报/公告将Desktop Metal列为破产后终止经营，不应列为当前正常在售。

title: Desktop Metal Production System P-50 product page
key_point: 大批量粘结剂喷射代表机型，但不能按旧网页仍在线推断当前可购买。

title: Desktop Metal Studio System 2 copper evidence
key_point: A-官方明确（历史资料）：Desktop Metal官方Studio System铜材料数据表明确Copper材料。

title: Desktop Metal Studio System 2 product page
key_point: 历史上是办公室级粘结金属路线；采购和售后状态必须视为中断风险。

title: Digital Metal / Nano Dimension official website
key_point: Current/retained binder-jet line; ownership structure in transition in 2026

title: Digital Metal / Nano Dimension PX100 product page
key_point: 标准构建高度70 mm，手册另示更高构建模块选项。Nano Dimension 2026年公告称出售Markforged时保留Metal Binder Jetting业务；采购主体须核实。

title: A Review on Extrusion Additive Manufacturing of Pure Copper
key_point: Binder Jet/MEX/VPP 中升温过快、绿坯不均、粘结剂残留或气体排出受阻会产生裂纹、鼓泡、碳/氧污染。

title: Additive manufacturing of pure copper via vat photopolymerization with slurry
evidence_level: 同行评审论文（单篇实验）
key_point: 铜浆料光固化能够制造高复杂度形状，但高铜体积分数使黏度急升并限制光固化深度。

title: Advancement of extreme environment additively manufactured alloys for next generation space propulsion applications
evidence_level: 同行评审论文/NASA 作者团队
key_point: GRCop-42 将 GRCop-84 的 Cr、Nb 减半，以换取更高热导；GRCop-84 通常强度更高。

title: Cold spray additive manufacturing of copper-based materials: Review and future directions
key_point: 颗粒速度不足、氧化层、喷射角不佳或表面污染会导致绝热剪切/塑性结合不足，出现层间弱界面和孔隙。

title: Current trends in electron beam and laser powder bed fusion additive manufacturing of copper alloys
key_point: 润湿不足、表面氧化、过低能量或过高速度可使熔道收缩成珠，造成粗糙、搭接不足和层间缺陷。

title: Effect of Laser Heat Input on Pure Copper Layer Formation by Wire-Based Directed Energy Deposition Using Blue Diode Laser
evidence_level: 同行评审论文（单篇实验）
key_point: 蓝光直接加热送丝可提高能量利用，并通过让激光而非基材导热承担主要熔丝热量来降低稀释。

title: Enhanced electrical and mechanical properties of additively manufactured pure copper with green laser
evidence_level: 同行评审论文（单篇实验）
key_point: 同行评审研究显示，经参数优化后，绿光 PBF-LB 可同时获得近全致密和高电导率。

title: Impacts of process-induced porosity on material properties of copper made by binder jetting additive manufacturing
evidence_level: 同行评审论文（单篇实验）
key_point: 粘结剂喷射避开激光反射难题，但最终性能主要由烧结后孔隙决定。

title: Laser metal deposition of copper on diverse metals using green laser sources
evidence_level: 同行评审论文（研究窗口）
key_point: 同轴送粉与可见光激光可在基材上沉积纯铜，适合修复、包覆、梯度材料和大件近净成形。

title: Mechanical, Electrical, and Thermal Characterization of Pure Copper Parts Manufactured via Material Extrusion AM
key_point: 绿坯密度梯度、重力、摩擦和不均匀脱脂会造成各向异性收缩和翘曲，复杂薄壁与厚薄突变最敏感。

title: Microstructure and properties of CuCrZr alloy fabricated by wire arc additive manufacturing
evidence_level: 同行评审论文（单篇实验）
key_point: CuCrZr 电弧增材会沿高度产生不同晶粒形貌和各向异性；需控制热积累与层间温度。

title: On the Processability and Microstructural Evolution of CuCrZr in Multilayer Laser-Directed Energy Deposition
evidence_level: 同行评审论文（研究窗口）
key_point: CuCrZr 可用高功率近红外激光送粉沉积；功率、扫描速度、送粉量与搭接共同决定未熔合、稀释率和层高。

title: On the Use of Green and Blue Laser Sources for Powder Bed Fusion: State of the Art Review for Additive Manufacturing of Copper and Its Alloys
key_point: 约 445–450 nm 蓝光对铜耦合更强，但光束质量、可用功率、聚焦和扫描系统决定其是否适合精细 PBF。

title: Optimum strength and ductility of pure copper fabricated by Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing
evidence_level: 同行评审论文（单篇实验）
key_point: 电弧送丝不受光学反射影响，适合大尺寸、高沉积率，但铜高导热使层间热历史、几何稳定和晶粒粗化控制困难。

title: Physical and chemical surface modification by laser polishing of CuZn42 parts produced by laser powder bed fusion
key_point: 黄铜可做 LPBF，但 Zn 沸点低，激光熔化时易选择性挥发，导致成分漂移、蒸汽羽流、飞溅和孔隙。

title: Polymer-metal powders melt extrusion printing to produce high-density, high-conductivity pure copper components
evidence_level: 同行评审论文（单篇实验）
key_point: 高填充金属-聚合物喂料经脱脂烧结，可获得高密度、高延性纯铜。

title: Porosity, texture, and mechanical properties of pure copper fabricated by fine green laser powder bed fusion
evidence_level: 同行评审论文（研究窗口）
key_point: 文献在固定 30 µm 层厚下，用功率、速度和道间距扫描致密化窗口。

title: Process of Pure Copper Fabricated by Selective Laser Melting Technology under Moderate Laser Power with Re-Melting Strategy
evidence_level: 同行评审论文（单篇实验）
key_point: 研究用二次扫描在 350 W 条件下提高中功率近红外纯铜密度，但结果仍低于高端绿光/高功率工艺。

title: Processing of pure copper by powder bed fusion with infrared laser
evidence_level: 同行评审论文（研究窗口）
key_point: 1060–1080 nm 光纤激光对冷态铜耦合差，需要高光强、合适聚焦或进入稳定匙孔/多重反射状态；反射光还可能威胁光学系统。

title: Reuse of pure copper in electron beam powder bed fusion
evidence_level: 同行评审论文（单篇实验）
key_point: 在持续补充新粉并严格控湿的复用策略下，研究实现了长期稳定的高致密和高电导纯铜。

title: Surface Roughness Formation in Powder Bed Fusion of Copper Using Gaussian and Ring-Shaped Laser Beam Profiles
evidence_level: 同行评审论文（单篇实验）
key_point: 同一体参数之外，轮廓曝光显著影响侧壁粗糙度。

title: EOS EOS M 290 1kW product page
key_point: 红外高功率路线，导电率数字来自该机型对应的官方CuCP工艺数据。

title: EOS EOS M 290 product page
key_point: 与1 kW版本的CuCP工艺不要混为一谈；本行是标准M 290与EOS Copper Cu。

title: EOS EOS M 300-4 1kW product page
